TextBlock.Text: LUMA: The Ash Twin Project has been approved. Construction will begin soon...
LAURUS: You sound concerned, my dear. What troubles you?
LUMA: We have achieved knowledge and technology that no other lifeform has come close to comprehending.
LUMA: And now, we begin constructing the bridge that will connect us to the Eye of the Universe.
LAURUS: But this is all great news, Luma. This confirms our efforts were not in vain.

LUMA: What you say is true. However, I cannot help but feel a sense of dread in knowing we are finally reaching the source of the signal, and with it, the conclusion of our journey. I wonder... when the journey ends, what becomes of the travelers?
